  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.batting_team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
  WHERE d.inning = 1
    AND m.team_type = 'international'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
)
SELECT
  batting_team,
  SUM(runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(legal_balls), 0) AS run_rate
FROM first_innings
